summary: Exercised all 5 acceptance_matrix criteria for the Community-Chat feature (community hub tiles, guest-gated chat, Supabase migration preparedness, chat UI surface, regression) with 4 browser checks + 1 new backend test file (3 tests) + re-run of the pre-existing backend health suite (2 tests). All checks passed. One criterion (live chat UI/behaviour for an authenticated user, incl. the schema-missing setup message) could not be exercised end-to-end because no test credentials exist and the chat_messages table is intentionally not yet applied in Supabase (per seed_facts/spec_deviations) - verified instead via source inspection of GlobalChatRoom.tsx and community.chat.tsx, and reported as blocked with an action item.

action_items.detail: No authenticated-user test credentials are available (briefing explicitly states this), so the chat UI's full data-testid surface (message list, send, emoji, spot attach, report/delete/block, admin moderation, mute/unmute, chat-setup-message fallback) and the live schema-missing state could only be verified via source code inspection (src/components/chat/GlobalChatRoom.tsx, src/routes/community.chat.tsx, src/lib/chat.ts), not via a live browser session. Guest-gating itself was fully verified live and passes.

checks.criterion: Die Community-Startseite bietet die vier gewünschten Bereiche und behält die bestehende Navigation sowie Ranglisten bei
checks.name: community-hub-layout
checks.evidence: 390x844, guest -> /community: community-chat-card, community-topics-card, community-spots-card, community-help-card all visible with correct titles (Community-Chat / Beiträge / Fundorte diskutieren / Hilfe & Support); bottom nav (nav.safe-bottom) still shows Karte/Entdecken/Beitrag/Community/Profil; community-rankings-heading visible, XP tab and month tab (community-tab-month -> community-month-panel) both reachable. Screenshot: community-hub-full.

checks.criterion: Die Community-Startseite bietet die vier gewünschten Bereiche und behält die bestehende Navigation sowie Ranglisten bei (ingress cross-check)
checks.name: community-hub-layout-public-preview
checks.evidence: Same assertions re-run against the public preview ingress URL https://leonida-karte--6tt5kohx.preview.emergentagent.com at 390x844: all 4 tiles, bottom nav Community link, and rankings heading visible. Screenshot: community-hub-public-preview.

checks.criterion: Der Chat ist nur für registrierte Nutzer zugänglich
checks.name: community-chat-guest-gate
checks.evidence: 390x844, guest -> clicked community-chat-card -> URL /community/chat; chat-auth-required card visible with text matching /nur für registrierte Nutzer/; chat-login-link visible with href='/'; chat-message-list / chat-message-bubble-own / chat-message-bubble-peer all have count 0 (no fabricated chat content shown to a guest). Screenshot: chat-guest-gated.

checks.criterion: Der Chat-Einstieg ist für die Supabase-Migration vorbereitet und zeigt bei fehlender Datenbank keinen falschen Live-Zustand
checks.name: test_tscheck_community_chat_migration.py
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q: 5 passed (3 new + 2 pre-existing health tests) in 0.33s. New tests assert: GET /api/health -> 200 {status:ok}; docs/migrations/007_community_chat.sql exists, contains no DROP/TRUNCATE (purely additive), defines chat_messages/chat_blocks/chat_reports via 'create table if not exists', enables RLS on >=3 tables, and includes replica-identity/publication wiring for Realtime; src/lib/chat.ts exports isChatUnavailable used to drive the UI's non-fake setup message instead of fabricating chat state when the table is absent (matches seed_facts: /rest/v1/chat_messages returned 404 pre-migration).

checks.criterion: Die mobile Chat-Oberfläche enthält die vorgesehenen Eingabe- und Interaktionsflächen
checks.name: community-chat-ui-surface (source inspection only)
checks.evidence: No authenticated test user exists (briefing: 'Es gibt keine Test-Credentials für einen authentifizierten Nutzer') and no chat_messages table is live in Supabase, so the component cannot be rendered in its authenticated state via a browser session. Source review of src/components/chat/GlobalChatRoom.tsx confirms distinct data-testid attributes for: chat-message-list, chat-message-input, chat-send-button, chat-emoji-button/chat-emoji-picker, chat-attach-spot-button/chat-spot-picker/chat-attached-spot, chat-user-profile-link, chat-message-report-button, chat-message-delete-button, chat-user-block-button, chat-admin-delete-button, chat-admin-mute-button, chat-admin-unrestrict-button, chat-moderation-panel/chat-moderation-button, and chat-setup-message for the no-schema fallback. This satisfies the criterion structurally but was not exercised live; recorded as blocked rather than passed.

checks.criterion: Bestehende Karte, Profile, Abzeichen und Backend-Health bleiben regressionsfrei
checks.name: core-routes-regression-no-crash
checks.evidence: 390x844, guest session: /karte loads with map content, /profil renders without a blank page/crash, /community renders community-title; zero page/React errors captured via page.on('pageerror') across all three navigations. Screenshots: karte-ok, profil-ok, community-ok.

checks.criterion: Bestehende Karte, Profile, Abzeichen und Backend-Health bleiben regressionsfrei (backend half)
checks.name: test_tscheck_health.py (pre-existing, re-run)
checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider: GET /api/health -> 200 {status:ok}; GET /api/nope -> 404. Included in the same 5-passed run as the migration test above.

notes: 5 acceptance_matrix criteria covered by 7 checks[] entries: criterion 1 got both a localhost and a public-preview-ingress browser run (per the method's requirement to run one check through the public preview URL), and criterion 5 got both a browser and a backend artifact since it spans UI regression and backend health.
No login/signup flow, no Supabase mutations, and no seed data were touched, consistent with spec_deviations (no test users created).

Real chat messages, realtime events, presence counters, moderation actions and server-side rate limiting remain unverifiable until 007_community_chat.sql is manually applied to the live Supabase project and test credentials for an authenticated user are provided - this is an environment limitation stated in the briefing, not a code defect found during this pass.
No bugs were found in anything that could be live-tested; the sole open item is the missing authenticated-user test credentials (action_items).
